blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Tatiana Prozorova said she was forced to withdraw from her Singapore Open women’s singles semifinal after a ball off an opponent’s smash hit her face during a doubles match on Friday night. Prozorova and her partner Sofya Lansere were three points away from losing their quarterfinal match before Japan’s Miyu Kato inadvertently hit her. “Guys, unfortunately, the organizers withdrew me from the WTA Singapore Open 500 [semifinal match],” Prozorova posted on Instagram. “Today, during the doubles match, one of the opponents hit a smash in my direction; it grazed my cheek and hit my shoulder. Things like that happen sometimes.” READ: […]... Keep on reading: WTA says 'health and safety' first after Tatiana Prozorova exit
